title: 被几乎没有的空气杀死的望远镜

segments.zh: A NASA telescope just fell out of the sky.
segments.en: 一台 NASA 望远镜刚刚从天上掉下来，

segments.zh: It burned up over Indonesia on November fourth.
segments.en: 十一月四日在印度尼西亚上空烧掉了。

segments.zh: Its name was Swift.
segments.en: 它叫 Swift（雨燕），

segments.zh: It weighed about fourteen hundred and fifty kilos.
segments.en: 重约一千四百五十公斤。

segments.zh: What killed it?
segments.en: 是什么杀死了它？

segments.zh: Air. Almost nothing but air.
segments.en: 空气。几乎什么都没有的空气。

segments.zh: Today's brain teaser:
segments.en: 今天的烧脑问题：

segments.zh: how does nearly empty space pull down a telescope?
segments.en: 几乎空荡荡的太空，怎么能把望远镜拽下来？

segments.zh: Meet Swift: launched in two thousand four,
segments.en: 认识 Swift：2004 年发射，

segments.zh: about six hundred kilometers up.
segments.en: 在大约六百公里高的地方。

segments.zh: Its job: catch gamma ray bursts,
segments.en: 它的任务：抓伽马射线暴，

segments.zh: the biggest explosions in the universe.
segments.en: 宇宙里最猛烈的爆炸。

segments.zh: It could swing around and point
segments.en: 它能在大约一分钟里转身对准目标，

segments.zh: in about a minute. Hence the name.
segments.en: 所以叫“雨燕”。

segments.zh: Planned life: two years.
segments.en: 原计划只工作两年，

segments.zh: It worked for almost twenty two.
segments.en: 结果干了将近二十二年。

segments.zh: It caught more than a thousand of those bursts.
segments.en: 它抓到了一千多次伽马暴，

segments.zh: Not bad for a two year plan.
segments.en: 对一个两年的计划来说，相当不错。

segments.zh: Now the physics.
segments.en: 现在讲物理：在轨道上，

segments.zh: In orbit, Swift is falling all the time.
segments.en: Swift 其实一直在往下掉。

segments.zh: It just moves sideways so fast
segments.en: 只是它横着飞得太快，

segments.zh: that it keeps missing the ground.
segments.en: 总是掉不到地面上。

segments.zh: About seven point six kilometers per second.
segments.en: 每秒大约七点六公里，

segments.zh: Around the whole world in ninety six minutes.
segments.en: 九十六分钟绕地球一圈。

segments.zh: But up there, there's still a tiny bit of air.
segments.en: 可那么高的地方，还有一丁点空气，

segments.zh: Like a whisper of a headwind.
segments.en: 就像一阵极轻的逆风。

segments.zh: Every orbit, that whisper steals
segments.en: 每绕一圈，这阵逆风

segments.zh: a tiny bit of energy.
segments.en: 就偷走它一点点能量。

segments.zh: Lose energy, drop a little lower.
segments.en: 能量少了，就降低一点；

segments.zh: Lower air is thicker, so it steals more.
segments.en: 越低空气越浓，偷得越多。

segments.zh: It's a snowball.
segments.en: 像滚雪球：

segments.zh: Slow at first, then very fast.
segments.en: 一开始很慢，后来非常快。

segments.zh: Twist one: as it drops,
segments.en: 反转一：往下掉的时候，

segments.zh: Swift actually speeds up.
segments.en: Swift 反而越飞越快。

segments.zh: A lower orbit is a faster orbit.
segments.en: 轨道越低，绕得越快。

segments.zh: Drag makes satellites go faster. Weird, but true.
segments.en: 空气阻力让卫星加速，怪，但是真的。

segments.zh: Twist two: the Sun
segments.en: 反转二：是太阳

segments.zh: made the air thicker.
segments.en: 把空气变浓了。

segments.zh: When the Sun is very active, it heats the upper air,
segments.en: 太阳活跃时，会把高层大气加热，

segments.zh: and the air puffs up, like bread rising.
segments.en: 空气就像面包发酵一样鼓起来。

segments.zh: Suddenly there's more air at Swift's height.
segments.en: 于是 Swift 那个高度，突然多了空气。

segments.zh: More air, more drag.
segments.en: 空气越多，阻力越大。

segments.zh: The Sun has been in a busy stretch of its eleven year cycle.
segments.en: 太阳正处在十一年周期里很忙的一段。

segments.zh: NASA says that made the decay worse.
segments.en: NASA 说，这让下降更快了。

segments.zh: By late October,
segments.en: 到十月下旬，

segments.zh: Swift was down to about two hundred seventy five kilometers.
segments.en: Swift 只剩大约二百七十五公里高。

segments.zh: So NASA tried something new:
segments.en: 于是 NASA 试了个新办法：

segments.zh: a robot rescue.
segments.en: 派机器人去救它。

segments.zh: A company called Catalyst built a robot spacecraft named Link,
segments.en: 一家叫 Katalyst 的公司造了救援飞船 LINK，

segments.zh: to grab Swift and push it higher.
segments.en: 要抓住 Swift，把它推高。

segments.zh: It launched in July,
segments.en: 它七月发射，

segments.zh: on a rocket dropped from an airplane.
segments.en: 用的是从飞机上扔下去的火箭。

segments.zh: But the rescue did not work out in time.
segments.en: 可救援没能及时成功，

segments.zh: The exact reasons haven't been made fully public.
segments.en: 具体原因还没有完全公开。

segments.zh: Twist three: the fireball
segments.en: 反转三：那团火球，

segments.zh: does not come from friction.
segments.en: 不是摩擦出来的。

segments.zh: Swift hit thick air at about twenty seven thousand kilometers an hour.
segments.en: Swift 以每小时两万七千公里冲进浓空气，

segments.zh: The air in front couldn't get out of the way.
segments.en: 前面的空气根本来不及让开。

segments.zh: Squeezed air gets super hot,
segments.en: 空气被猛压，就变得超级烫，

segments.zh: like a bike pump getting warm, but far more extreme.
segments.en: 像打气筒会发热，只是猛烈得多。

segments.zh: That squeezed air glows,
segments.en: 被压缩的空气发光，

segments.zh: and the spacecraft melts and breaks apart.
segments.en: 飞船熔化、解体。

segments.zh: Most of Swift burned up.
segments.en: Swift 大部分都烧掉了。

segments.zh: NASA put the risk to anyone on the ground at about one in twenty one hundred.
segments.en: NASA 估计，伤到地面任何人的概率约二千一百分之一。

segments.zh: Fine print: why the rescue failed
segments.en: 友情提示：救援为什么失败，

segments.zh: is still mostly unexplained in public.
segments.en: 目前公开的信息还不多。

segments.zh: And drag changes with the Sun,
segments.en: 而且阻力跟着太阳变，

segments.zh: so reentry times always come with hours of uncertainty.
segments.en: 所以坠落时间总有十几个小时的误差。

segments.zh: So how does almost nothing pull down a telescope?
segments.en: 几乎没有的空气，怎么拽下望远镜？

segments.zh: A tiny push, every orbit, for twenty two years.
segments.en: 每圈推一下，推了二十二年。

segments.zh: Swift was named for speed.
segments.en: Swift 因速度得名，

segments.zh: In the end, speed is what burned it.
segments.en: 最后也是速度把它烧掉了。
